item.description: It is primary day in a handful of states and voters are heading to the polls with key races up for grabs that could signal which direction the parties are headed before the November midterms. One of the most closely watched contests is taking place in Michigan, which has become the Democrat’s most expensive Senate primary race ever. NBC’s Shaquille Brewster reports and Steve Kornacki joins TODAY with analysis.
